translations: And leave Me and the deniers
puzzle.hint: A verse about the special night vigil prayer (Tahajjud) and the noble 'Maqam Mahmud' (praised station) promised by Allah.
puzzle.arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
puzzle.verseEn: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
